name: ctest
description: CTest: CMake's test driver; runs the tests a CMake build registers.
title: ctest

llmHints.on_match: CTest observed. --output-junit junit.xml (relative to the build directory) writes one JUnit testcase per CTest test, captured by test-results. A test CTest could not run (missing executable, missing REQUIRED_FILES, failed fixture) is written as skipped; test-results counts it as an error.

negativeSetup: Invoke cilock with unrelated argv (e.g. `echo unrelated`)
